overview_description.description:
Smileneo is a health technology company that allows doctors to participate in the digitalization of teeth straightening. It provides Smileneo Invisible Braces that are stain-resistant, BPA- and phthalate-free, and gently move teeth to their desired position.

It provides a seamless experience without sacrificing patient care thanks to fully digital processes and end-to-end 3D technology. Its mobile application takes convenience to the next level by eliminating recurring clinic visits for patients and allowing remote monitoring by their doctor.

product.name: Smileneo Invisible Braces
product.description: Custom-made clear plastic aligners that gradually straighten teeth, monitored remotely via a mobile app, with treatment planned by orthodontists.

product.name: Doctor Consultation
product.description: In-person dental examination including 3D scans, X-rays, and photos to assess teeth and create a personalized treatment plan.

product.name: Smileneo Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application for patients to monitor their treatment progress, track wearing time, take progress photos, receive reminders, and communicate with their doctor.

product.name: Invisible Retainers
product.description: Removable or fixed retainers used after treatment to maintain teeth position and prevent relapse.
